purpose: Run the unmodified candidate validator with all 38 LunarLander policies in a fresh environment, retaining a feasible execution time. The default-thread partial run-b is retained separately, including its aggregate-disagreement. No threshold, code, checkpoint or historical result was changed.
basis: A preserved single-policy diagnostic reproduced the default-thread DQN failure with identical compared episode records. This does not establish that threading is immaterial to every policy or constitute a controlled performance benchmark.
qualification: This is not an unqualified completion of default-environment run B. Its result must be reported with the explicit runtime settings.
